name: Human
description: Adaptable people found almost anywhere, known for versatility and nerve.

name: High Elf
description: Graceful folk touched by old magic and long memory.

name: Wood Elf
description: Swift, watchful elves at home in wild places.

traits.name: Wild Step
traits.description: Move quickly and hide more naturally in wilderness.

name: Drow
description: Elves shaped by underground realms and shadowed magic.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: See farther in darkness than most.

traits.name: Drow Magic
traits.description: Gain shadow-themed magic as you advance.

name: Hill Dwarf
description: Hardy folk with deep endurance and stubborn survival instincts.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Resist poison and endure harsh conditions.

name: Mountain Dwarf
description: Stout warriors and artisans of stone halls and high passes.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: Resist poison and endure harsh conditions.

name: Lightfoot Halfling
description: Small, warm-hearted travelers with luck and a talent for not being noticed.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: Better at hiding behind larger creatures.

name: Stout Halfling
description: Resilient halflings with courage bigger than their boots.

name: Forest Gnome
description: Clever, curious, and close to small woodland creatures.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: Strong defenses against some magical effects.

name: Rock Gnome
description: Inventive gnomes with quick minds and busy hands.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: Strong defenses against some magical effects.

name: Dragonborn
description: Proud heirs of draconic power, carrying elemental force in blood and breath.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Choose an element that shapes breath weapon and resistance.

name: Tiefling
description: People marked by infernal legacy, often dramatic through no fault of their tailoring.

traits.name: Infernal Legacy
traits.description: Gain small infernal magic as you grow.

name: Orc
description: Powerful, relentless folk who refuse to fall quietly.

name: Goliath
description: Large-framed mountain folk carrying echoes of giant ancestry.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description: Choose a giant-linked defensive or utility trait.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: Carry and push more than size suggests.

name: Aasimar
description: Mortals touched by celestial power, bright in ways both helpful and inconvenient.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.description: Heal a creature with limited celestial energy.

name: Half-Elf
description: People between worlds, often socially flexible and perceptive.

name: Firbolg
description: Quiet giant-kin with gentle magic and a talent for disappearing when necessary.

traits.name: Natural Speech
traits.description: Communicate simple meaning to beasts and plants.
